name: KNR System Inc.
summary: Based in Yongin, South Korea, KNR System Inc. specializes in the development and production of a comprehensive array of advanced testing solutions. The company's extensive offerings include sophisticated systems for automotive applications, encompassing chassis, powertrain, component, motor, and valve evaluations. They also provide specialized packages for craft industries, specifically for train and vessel testing. KNR System Inc. further addresses the civil engineering sector with systems designed for material, structural, high-force, and large-scale assessments, in addition to general energy and material/component testing platforms. Beyond its core testing equipment, KNR is actively involved in robotics, manufacturing intelligent bio-robot platforms (I and II) for clinical diagnostics and specialized robot platforms for digital 3D fluoroscopy. Their hydraulic robot line features rotatory actuators and manipulators, and they engineer specific robot systems for gear shift testing. The company also undertakes product development for military and various mobile platform applications. Complementing its manufacturing capabilities, KNR provides professional testing services through its dedicated automotive, train, and civil engineering laboratories.
